Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring notice of employees' rights related to unions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to notice of employees' rights related to unions;and adding a new section to chapter 49.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall include information regarding employees'rights related to union membership and dues in any workplace posterrequired to be posted by this chapter or the rules adopted under thischapter. (2) The public employment relations commission shall developlanguage to educate and advise employees regarding their rights relatedto union membership and dues. The language must include, at a minimum,information related to nonassociation rights and agency fees. No laterthan ninety days after the effective date of this section and annuallythereafter, the public employment relations commission shall transmitthe language developed under this subsection to the department forinclusion in the workplace poster. (3) This section does not require the department to reprint a p. 1 HB 1461required workplace poster in advance of the established printingschedule.
